import sys

def main():
    s = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    
    res = 0
    if s and len(s) > 1:
        n = len(s)
        start = 0
        for i in range(1, n + 1):
            if i == n or s[i] != s[start]:
                if ((i - start) & 1) == 0:
                    res += 1
                start = i
    print(res)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
